name: settings-popup
title: Settings Popup
description: A settings menu that springs out of its own trigger on hover. The panel grows from the button on a back.out overshoot while the glass under it squashes and stretches like a drop settling, the rows unblur out of a pill-shaped clip, and closing anticipates before folding back into the button.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/component/settings-popup
The panel is pinned to the trigger corner set by align, so it opens over the button instead of below it.
